notes: Loop 2, German first. Since loop 1 (7.5) the lesson has a predict-then-check box before the break-even (src/report/sections.ts:491), Keep starts at 7 with the sunk-cost reason (report.txt:552), the worst case names the guess it rests on (report.txt:235), one true sentence says who played the customers (report.txt:61-62, 334), a bridge ties the rehearsal to the guess (report.txt:363) and an 'after the test' demo closes the loop. Four of six loop-1 items are fixed, two partly. What holds it below 8: (1) /try, Selin's path without an AI app, never asks lunch spend, setup, staff or promotion (src/engine/templates.ts:27,33-36 optional). With the placeholder values the UI bot typed, the report says break-even 0, worst case +100 €, and 'jeder senkt Ihre Einnahmen um etwa 0,00 €' (rendered from those inputs). The switching and setup lessons vanish. (2) The predict box's answer, 'Break-even: 11', is on the same phone screen (report-slider-moved.png, box still empty). (3) The 'Flat White und der Mindestlohn 2027' demo never uses or cites the minimum wage. Both facts cards hold only VAT, and the VAT mix sits under 'Schätzungen … Ihr Test prüft sie' (report.txt:108-117). (4) The German swaps terms: Break-even/Gewinnschwelle, ausgedacht/erdacht, Startkosten/Einrichtung.
improvements: /try main path (site/src/try.ts requiredFields, src/engine/templates.ts:27 and 33-36): make lunch_spend a required screen ('Was gibt ein Mittagsgast aus? Mittags oft mehr als Ihr Durchschnittsbon') and add one screen 'Was kostet Sie der Test?' with setup, extra staff hours (showing 13,90 € as the dated minimum wage if she has no own hourly cost) and promotion. When a fallback turns switching into a gain or the break-even into 0, show that warning above 'Die kurze Antwort', not inside the closed 'Gut zu wissen'. Fix src/engine/experiment.ts:124, where Math.max(0, gap) prints 'senkt … um etwa 0,00 €'. Why: scaffolding and misconceptions. The report's two hardest ideas (regulars who switch cost money, the test must pay back its setup) come from exactly the inputs /try skips, so a quick owner learns 'a lunch deal is free money'. It worked when a /try run with the placeholders gives a break-even above 0, a setup line, a switching cost and two thresholds, like the demo, and try-walkthrough.txt lists the new screens.

Step 4 predict-then-check (src/report/mount.ts:214-270 cover(), src/report/sections.ts:473 predictFeedback): until she guesses or skips, also hide the explorer's 'Break-even: 11' and 'Trägt sich: 7' markers, the '(dafür braucht es 11)' clause in 'Warum sich das geändert hat' and 'Gut zu wissen'. Make the feedback diagnostic for low guesses, in her own numbers: 'Zwei Dinge übersieht das Bauchgefühl oft: Von 9,90 € bleiben nach Mehrwertsteuer und Zutaten nur 5,35 €, und 11 wechselnde Stammgäste kosten 13,57 € am Tag, bevor ein neuer Gast kommt.' Why: active learning only works if the answer is not visible while she guesses, and feedback should explain the gap, not only measure it ('8 mehr, als Sie dachten'). It worked when report-phone.png shows no '11' within one screen of the empty box, and a guess of 4 returns the two-cost sentence.

Facts as worked examples (src/report/demo.ts:171-180, src/report/sections.ts step2): the price demo promises 'Flat White und der Mindestlohn 2027' (landing.txt:82, 269) but the report never uses the minimum wage (its facts card lists only VAT). Add one computed line, for example 'Mindestlohn +0,70 € pro Stunde × Ihre Personalstunden pro Woche = … € mehr Lohnkosten; die 20 Cent bringen bei −4 % netto … € pro Woche', with the minimum-wage fact (source, link, Stand 1. Januar 2026 / 2027) in its facts card. In both demos, take the blended VAT row out of 'Schätzungen, die noch niemand kennt … Ihr Test prüft sie'. Show it as 'Ihre Mischung Speisen/Getränke (geschätzt 70/30) → 10,6 %' with a fact chip for 7 %/19 % and a guess chip for the mix. Why: the facts card should teach a third kind of number, public and dated. Today a learner reads 'Mehrwertsteuer … Eine Schätzung' first, and the test cannot check it. It worked when every fact named in a demo question appears in its facts card and is used in a maths line, and no VAT row sits in the test-checks box.

/try reports without an AI (src/report/rehearsal.ts empty state, messages 'reh.empty2', 'tc.back'): for madeBy 'try', offer 'Probelauf hier starten (einfache feste Regeln, keine KI)' using ruleBasedReactions in the browser. Replace 'Bitten Sie Ihren KI-Coach' and 'Sagen Sie dem Coach, was Sie gemessen haben' with the /try wording ('Tragen Sie Ihr Ergebnis ein'). Why: the closed-beta owner with no AI app never experiences the AI-literacy lesson 'imagined customers are not data', and she is told to ask a coach she does not have. It worked when a /try report can show step 5 with the rule-based caveat and no 'Coach' wording.

Retrieval before 'Was Sie gelernt haben' (src/report/sections.ts closing / step6 test card): add a two-question self-check using the decision rule just agreed. 'Im Test kommen im Schnitt 6 zusätzliche Gäste pro Tag: Behalten, Anpassen oder Beenden?' and 'Die Startkosten sind ausgegeben: zählen sie für das Behalten noch?' Give tap answers and one-line feedback from the plan's own thresholds. Why: transfer and sunk-cost are now taught well but only told; applying the rule once before the real test is the cheapest retrieval practice. It worked when the demo shows the self-check above 'Was Sie gelernt haben' and wrong answers get the specific threshold back.

After-the-test demo (src/report/sections.ts:650 and :642): the measured '6' wears chip('owner') 'Ihre Zahl' although the demo's counts are made up. Use the demo chip when analysis.demo. Give the 'Was Sie gemessen haben' list its units ('Tatsächliche Einrichtungskosten 180' should read 180 €). After a result, lead 'Was Sie gelernt haben' with measured against guess ('Sie hatten 8 geschätzt, gemessen wurden 6, und es wechselten 21 % statt 30 %') instead of repeating the pre-test text. Why: the feedback loop is the transfer lesson; a wrong source label in the one place that shows real-vs-guess undoes the labelling lesson. It worked when #demo-result shows 'Demo-Daten' on the measured value and the closing lesson cites the measurement.
misconceptionsRisked: 'A lunch deal costs nothing if regulars switch': on the /try quick path the lunch spend defaults to the all-day average (7,40 €), so switching looks like a gain. Break-even 0, worst case +100 €, and the test card says each switcher lowers takings by '0,00 €' (src/engine/templates.ts:27, experiment.ts:124).

'VAT is one of my guesses, and my test will check it': the blended 10,6 % sits in the highlighted 'Schätzungen, die noch niemand kennt … Ihr Test prüft sie' box with 'Eine Schätzung' (report.txt:108-117). The dated 7 %/19 % facts are in a card that is closed on the phone.
'Break-even is not where the line crosses zero': the landing's step-4 mini chart puts the break-even dot at x=122 while the line crosses zero at x≈93 (site/index.html:145).

'Break-even and Gewinnschwelle are two different numbers': the report says Break-even (report.txt:248, 282), while the landing and the closing lessons say Gewinnschwelle (landing.txt:142, static-de 'rechnen Sie die Gewinnschwelle aus'). Likewise 'ausgedacht' vs 'erdacht', 'Beenden' vs 'Aufhören'.
'The minimum-wage rise is part of the flat-white maths': the demo title and the question name it, but no number in that report uses it.
'The demo's measured result is my number': chip 'Ihre Zahl' on made-up demo counts (sections.ts:650).
'Erwartet is what will happen': the chart and table still label the likely guess 'Erwartet' (report.txt:171, 178), only softened by the subtitle 'Ihre wahrscheinliche Schätzung'.
scaffoldingGaps: The predict question's answer ('Break-even: 11', 'Trägt sich: 7', '(dafür braucht es 11)') is visible on the same screen while the box is empty. Feedback for guesses under 7 only gives the size of the gap.
/try asks 6 numbers on the main path. Every cost of the test (setup, staff, promotion), the lunch spend and the switching share sit in one closed 'Genauer machen (optional)' panel with 13 fields.
Only extra customers can be moved. The least intuitive mechanism (each switching regular costs 1,19 €) is told in a closed 'Gut zu wissen', never explored hands-on.
No retrieval or self-check: 'Was Sie gelernt haben' is told, and after a test result it does not change.
Owners using /try without an AI app get no rehearsal and are told to ask a 'KI-Coach'.
The Berlin facts card is closed by default on the phone; no maths line in either demo uses the minimum wage.
languageLoad: German is close to the English in sentence length and structure. It uses 'Sie', the number formats are right (9,90 €, 1.500 €, 22.481 €, −117,70 €) and 'Deckungsbeitrag' is avoided ('Marge' is glossed once). The extra load is vocabulary drift that English does not have: the English loan 'Break-even' in the step title and chart vs 'Gewinnschwelle' on the landing and in the lessons; 'Startkosten' vs 'Einrichtung' (predict.lowOngoing) vs 'Einrichtungskosten' (obs.actual_setup_cost); chip 'Ausgedacht' (report) vs 'Erdacht' (landing); 'Beenden' vs 'Aufhören'. A few calques remain: 'Ihre wahrscheinliche Schätzung, über den 10-Tage-Test', and 'Für jeden Tag nach dem Test reicht Ihre Schätzung (7 pro Tag)', which reads as if she had guessed 7. Polish uses the native 'Próg rentowności' and correct '1500 €'. But the landing says 'próg opłacalności' and its chips differ from the report's (Obliczone/Wyliczone, Wymyślone/Wyobrażone). Spanish keeps 'punto de equilibrio' throughout, but its chips also differ ('Una suposición' on the site vs 'Una estimación' in the report).
